Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 is here, but is it actually worth upgrading to? In this detailed Galaxy Z Fold 8 Review, we take a look at its design, display, performance, cameras, battery, software, Galaxy AI features, multitasking experience, and everything else you need to know before buying Samsung's latest foldable smartphone.
If you're planning to buy the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, looking for the best foldable phone, or wondering how it compares with other flagship foldables, this review will help you make the right decision.
